No conditional-write or version pinning exists in the code; bucket object-lock is infra config the code visibly does not rely on.

confirmUpload commits via transactionTemplate.execute(persistConfirmed) and only then calls applicationEventPublisher.publishEvent(StorageObjectConfirmedEvent) in-memory; persistConfirmed durably records only an OutboxReplicationJob (REPLICATE), so a crash between commit and publish loses the event. The sole re-drive is reconfirm, gated to client retries within uploadTtlSeconds of uploadConfirmedAt, matching the finding; no sweeper exists in this file and the finding's grep caveat reports none elsewhere.
